skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and characteristics of social issues and social change programs.
Master marketing principles and techniques for developing a social marketing program.
Design and develop a social marketing plan using mixed marketing tools.
Evaluate a mixed social marketing program for specific social behavior change scenarios and apply creative thinking to real-world social issues.
Conduct research on target publics in social marketing.
Identify potential publics and target publics in social marketing.
Propose marketing decisions on products, pricing, distribution, and communication for a social marketing program.
Apply ethical considerations in evaluating social marketing programs and promoting civic responsibility through social marketing.
